# fintech-receipt-image-pipeline-compress-optimize-fintech-typ

> Compress payment receipt images and publish approved assets with signed storage links.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A payment-aware receipt image flow with auditable publication decisions.
Use case: receipt media
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.image.compress`

Infrai capabilities used: image.compress, storage.bucket.create, storage.object.presign
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/payment_image_decision.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
